craft_notes: Sthāyin: spectacle-turned-joy (net/picture/whirl: even illusion is joy when witnessed). Rows: row 3 (seeing-all→joy). Close: upsurges (sukhodgama — the rising-word after v101's remains: rest→rise). Rejected: 'virtual reality' — killed: net kept (Indra's, classical); 'hallucination' — killed: picture-work kept (citrakarma as craft).

lines: Indra-net world, cast, or picture-work-like, whirling:
meditating all, seeing all — joy upsurges.
l4.sanskrit_cite: indrajālamayaṃ viśvaṃ vyastaṃ vā citrakarmavat | bhramad vā dhyāyataḥ sarvam paśyataś ca sukhodgamaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is the world seen as? → Seen as net and picture-whirl, all-seeing carries joy upsurge.
c1_essence: World as net or picture-whirl: seeing all, joy upsurges.
